name: Unit 4 Learning Goals
definition: 本单元学习描述伟大人物、谈论他们伟大的原因并学习他们的品质，了解连贯语音中的辅音-辅音连读。
key_points: 核心词汇：describe, talk about, learn from, great people, consonant-consonant liaison
核心句型：We will be able to ... / We can learn from ... / What can we learn from great people?
语法点：一般现在时表达能力 be able to；一般将来时 will be able to
common_mistakes: be able to 与 can 混用时态不一致
learn from 后忘记加宾语
great people 误用 great's people
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
